points.why: States the side effect feeds back into the same problem and makes it worse.
Names the competing fundamental solution and says dependence on the quick fix erodes the capacity to apply it.
The rushed-tickets example is a correct Fixes That Fail and the hero hot-fix example is a correct Shifting the Burden.

notes: Diagnostic 1 says Shifting the Burden's fix never addresses the problem while Fixes That Fail's briefly does; both archetypes really relieve only the symptom, so this test is shaky but not harmful.
